notes: The button that says you do not understand something now explains it. It used to mark the concept as lost and move straight on to the next question, which made it the only button in the app that answered I do not get this by changing the subject. It opens the lesson instead, and the question is still there afterward.

Every explanation in the course is a list now, not a wall. All 197 of them: the lede sentence, then the facts as bullets with the term that matters in bold, then the payoff. What was there before was three dense paragraphs per concept, at reading width, which is the shape you skim rather than read. Nothing was reworded to do it, and the build refuses any explanation that quietly gains a word it did not have before.

The syntax reference explains the words that do not compute anything, instead of running a program that happens to contain them. class, public, private, static, final and void each show their own skeleton line by line with what every line is for. The old class walkthrough squared a number inside a class, which is a fine demonstration of squaring a number.
